$comment: Amount representation. Amounts cross every boundary as decimal strings (grammar below) and are kept as exact decimals (BigDecimal / Decimal), never binary floating point. 'serialization': the JSON number literal written as 'amount' in POST /transactions. 'display': text shown to the payer; locale output differs between platforms (spaces, symbols), so only the visible digits are part of the contract.

parsing.note: Parses; rejected later by the minimum amount rule.

serialization.note: Trailing zeros are not significant. Android writes BigDecimal('100.50') as 100.50; both are the same JSON number. To be confirmed with SimPay that the API compares numerically.

display.note: A digit the amount carries is never hidden by rounding.
Unknown currency codes are shown verbatim.
